name: Mobile nav
summary: The navigation inside the mobile menu (Slideout "Menu" of Header). Items with subpages expand in place (accordion), with the same icons as in the Mega menu.
use: Inside the Header mobile menu. Header renders it from the same links.
avoid: Desktop: use Header with Mega menu.
anatomy: Mobile nav item: label and chevron, a divider below.
Subpages (Mobile nav sublink): icon and label.
figmaProps: _Mobile nav sublink: Label / Show icon / Icon
reactProps: The links of all columns of a menu are shown one after the other.
behaviour: One section is open at a time. The section with the current page starts open.
No padding of its own: the Slideout gives it.
a11y: A section is a <button aria-expanded aria-controls>; its links follow it.
Current page with aria-current="page" and the brand color on label and icon.
do: Put the search above the navigation, not inside it.
open: Column headings of a Mega menu are not shown on mobile; the links follow each other.
